description: What the broker guarantees a downstream LTI 1.1 provider receives. The broker produces these parameters; LabsConnect consumes them. Both sides test against this file, because the failure this exists to prevent lived in the gap between two internally consistent, well-tested codebases: the broker sent resource_link_id and LabsConnect read custom_lab_slug, so no grade cell was ever written and two courses lost a term of passback with nothing reporting it.

notes.custom_lab_slug: The provider's own name for the lab, from the route's provider_resource_id. A provider cannot identify the lab from resource_link_id, which is a broker route UUID it has never been told the meaning of. Omitted only when a route carries no slug.
notes.resource_link_id: The broker's route UUID. Stable per link, meaningless to the provider on its own.
notes.user_id: The upstream subject, forwarded unchanged, so it is stable across sections and terms.
notes.tool_consumer_instance_guid: Always the literal 'ltibroker'. LabsConnect's persistent-home key derivation depends on it being stable; see HOME_KEY_ISSUER.
notes.lis_result_sourcedid: Minted per launch. The sample value below is a placeholder, never a real token.
